operation.body:
### Goal

Implement category assignment and change (FR-003): users can set or update a feedback item's category from the allowed values.

### Acceptance criteria

- Only `bug`, `feature request`, and `other` are accepted for category updates.
- New submissions without an explicit category start as `other` (preserve existing FR-001 behaviour).
- A user can change an item's category from the show (or equivalent detail) view; the change persists after reload.
- After a failed category update, the user sees a readable error, stored data is unchanged, and the submission form remains usable for a subsequent valid new submission.
- Each category control has a unique ID and an explicitly associated label; verify with multiple items and keyboard interaction where this goal adds UI.
- Automated tests cover valid category changes, invalid category rejection, and default `other` on create at an appropriate boundary.
- Pull request contains exact `Closes #<this-issue-number>` and stays within this goal scope.

### Constraints

- Ruby on Rails, SQLite, server-rendered HTML; MIT license; no authentication.
- Build on FR-001/FR-002 flows on `main` (goals #9/#11, PRs #10/#12); do not regress create, validation, or inbox listing behaviour.
- Do not edit `docs/security-review.md` or implement goal #3 work.
- Report only checks that actually ran.

### Out of scope

- Category filters (FR-004), restart persistence demo (FR-005), invalid-category API handling beyond category update (FR-006), full FR-007/FR-008 delivery, sample dataset, and demo recording.

### Relevant context

`Feedback::CATEGORIES` and default `other` already exist on `main` at `0759aaf`. Inbox index lists category read-only today. Parent project #2 targets FR-001–FR-008 overall.
